name: India–Pakistan
value: Indus treaty in abeyance; no LoC strike
summary: India keeps the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance; troops fired near the LoC on 16 Nov; no cross-border strike
state: Indian troops opened fire after suspicious movement near the Line of Control in Poonch on 16 Nov, with no casualties or exchange with Pakistani forces reported (Telangana Today). India continues to hold the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance, which Pakistan has protested (Dawn). No cross-border strike or mobilisation was found as of 22 Nov, so Watch holds on the treaty suspension.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for India and Pakistan, which advises against travel near the Line of Control.

sources.title: Telangana Today — Army opens fire after suspicious movement near LoC in J&K's Poonch

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
